keys.effect: Texture resolution streaming mip level: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Ultra.
keys.notes: Ultra textures require 16 GB+ VRAM at 1440p and 4K resolutions. High (2) is recommended for GPUs with 8 GB to 12 GB VRAM to prevent VRAM allocation hitches.

keys.effect: Anisotropic texture filtering: 0=Bilinear, 1=2x, 2=4x, 3=8x, 4=16x.
keys.notes: Negligible GPU performance cost on modern hardware; 16x (4) provides crisp surface mipmaps at sharp viewing angles.

keys.effect: Rasterised shadow map resolution and filtering: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Highest.
keys.notes: Controls shadow map resolution. Setting to High or Highest yields sharp, stable shadows in open-world zones.

keys.effect: Volumetric fog grid resolution and atmospheric light sampling: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High.
keys.notes: High fog quality increases shadow casting through mist and dense atmosphere across Sanctuary dungeons.

keys.effect: Ragdoll simulation and destructible prop interaction fidelity: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High.
Particle effect count and rendering density: 0.5=Low, 0.75=Medium, 1.0=High.
keys.notes: During intense high-density mob encounters or legion events, High particles can stress GPU fill rate.

keys.effect: Ground clutter, small foliage, and debris density: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Ultra.
Animal, mount, and monster fur rendering strand quality: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High.
Ground Truth Ambient Occlusion sample quality: 0=Off, 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Ultra.
keys.notes: GTAO produces accurate ambient contact shadowing around characters, armour, and ground geometry.

keys.effect: Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) sample quality: 0=Low, 1=High.
keys.notes: Standard TAA can produce softness during camera motion. Overridden when using DLSS or DLAA.

keys.effect: Water surface wave simulation and dynamic ripple fidelity: 0=Low, 1=High.
Shader complexity and material lighting model: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High.
Screen space reflections toggle: 0=Off, 1=On.
Full-resolution screen space reflections toggle: 0=Half resolution (causes grain and noise), 1=Full resolution (sharp, grain-free).
keys.notes: Setting to 1 eliminates reflection dithering, temporal noise, and blur on wet surfaces and blood puddles.

keys.effect: Screen space distortion for explosions, shockwave effects, and heat haze: 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Disabling removes jarring optical screen warping and blur during combat spells and explosions.

keys.effect: Lens color separation/fringing post-process filter: 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Disabling ensures sharp edge delineation and prevents chromatic blur across the screen edges.

keys.effect: Disables peripheral RGB SDK integrations (Razer Chroma, Corsair iCUE): 0=Enabled, 1=Disabled.
keys.notes: Setting to 1 fixes widespread hitching, micro-stutters, and loading screen freezes caused by third-party RGB polling.

keys.effect: Master hardware ray tracing toggle: 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Requires DXR / DirectX 12 Ultimate hardware. Best paired with DLSS 3 Frame Generation on modern RTX GPUs.

keys.effect: Ray-traced reflection quality: 0=Off, 1=Medium, 2=High.
Ray-traced contact and sun shadow quality: 0=Off, 1=Medium, 2=High.
Ray-traced shadow casting for foliage and grass: 0=Off, 1=On.
Ray-traced illumination and self-shadowing on particle effects: 0=Off, 1=On.
Active upscaler algorithm: 0=None (Native), 1=AMD FSR 1, 2=AMD FSR 2, 3=NVIDIA DLSS, 4=Intel XeSS, 5=AMD FSR 3.
keys.notes: Set to 3 when using NVIDIA DLSS or DLAA.

keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution mode: 0=DLAA (Native AI Anti-Aliasing), 1=Quality, 2=Balanced, 3=Performance, 4=Ultra Performance.
keys.notes: Quality mode (1) or DLAA (0) provides superior temporal clarity over native TAA without ghosting or camera motion blur.

keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS 3 Frame Generation toggle: 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Requires GeForce RTX 40-series GPU and Windows Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS). Doubles framerate on high refresh rate displays.

keys.effect: NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency mode: 0=Off, 1=On, 2=On + Boost.
keys.notes: Reduces system input latency. Enabled automatically when DLSS Frame Generation is active.

keys.effect: DLSS and DLAA sharpening strength: 0.0 to 5.0.
keys.notes: A value of 1.5 to 2.0 provides sharp, detailed texture reproduction without creating ringing halos around character models.

keys.effect: Skips startup Blizzard logos and intro cinematics: 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Allows direct boot to character select.
